input.summary: Insert missing Section 20 (Indemnification): Vendor IP/legal/data-breach/misconduct indemnity, claim procedure, narrow Customer indemnity, and IP remedies (restoring the Section 20.5 cross-reference in 9.3).
input.comment: [Playbook] The Agreement has no indemnification section at all, even though Sections 9.3, 19.4, 21.3 and 30.5 assume one exists (9.3 cross-references "Section 20.5"). We have added the standard Vendor indemnity for third-party IP claims, breach of law, Vendor-caused data breach and wilful misconduct, with usual exclusions and remedies, plus a reciprocal but narrow Customer indemnity.

ops.text: 20.1 Vendor shall defend, indemnify and hold harmless Customer and its Affiliates from and against any third-party claim, and all resulting damages, liabilities, costs and expenses (including reasonable attorneys' fees), to the extent arising out of (a) an allegation that the Services, Deliverables or Vendor Technology infringe or misappropriate any intellectual property right; (b) Vendor's breach of Applicable Law; (c) any unauthorized access to or disclosure of Customer Data caused by Vendor; or (d) Vendor's gross negligence or wilful misconduct. 20.2 Vendor's obligation under Section 20.1(a) does not apply to the extent a claim arises from Customer's modification of the Services or Deliverables without Vendor's authorization, combination with items not supplied or recommended by Vendor, or Vendor's compliance with Customer's written specifications. 20.3 Customer shall indemnify Vendor against third-party claims to the extent arising out of content Customer provides to the Services in breach of this Agreement or Customer's breach of Applicable Law. 20.4 The indemnified Party shall give the indemnifying Party prompt written notice of the claim (delay does not excuse the indemnity except to the extent of resulting prejudice), the indemnifying Party shall control the defence with counsel reasonably acceptable to the indemnified Party, and the indemnified Party shall provide reasonable cooperation at the indemnifying Party's expense and may participate with its own counsel at its own cost. No settlement imposing a non-indemnified obligation or admission on the indemnified Party may be made without its consent. 20.5 If a claim under Section 20.1(a) arises or is reasonably likely, Vendor shall, at its expense, procure the necessary rights, or modify or replace the affected item with a functionally equivalent non-infringing item. If Vendor cannot do so within a reasonable period, Customer may terminate the affected Services or Deliverables and receive a refund of Fees paid for them, including prepaid Fees for the terminated period.
